title: Deeper/broader source-generated ACIS SAB control and live 3D queue reconciliation
mode: primary-source research and local plan/source inventory only
scope: Recheck the open-source DWG/DXF peer routes relevant to valid AC1032 SAB authoring, carrier transfer, and 3D consumer claims
Compare peer reports with the current MESH and AcDs test owners to remove completed work from the live 3D queue
Define a source-authored, bounded valid-SAB regression that does not require proprietary or downloaded drawings
Keep independent parser/kernel, FreeCAD platform, and support-claim evidence separate from local carrier tests

method.kind: Read-only review of public primary repository issues, project documentation, current local plan entries, and source-generated test inventory
method.limitations: Public issue reports are peer-specific and were not reproduced. Current project documentation is mutable. The proposed valid-SAB control is a plan item only; no SAB/DXF/DWG was generated or parsed in this research pass.

sources.observed: The reporter supplies a no-proprietary-file AC1032 DXF recipe that creates a REGION with a 5,489-byte SAB body via ezdxf, then reports that LibreDWG conversion keeps the entity but loses the SAB/AcDs carrier. A separate confidential R2018 observation is reporter-only and was not downloaded or independently reproduced.

The current published release notes continue to describe AcDsPrototype_1b as incomplete and characterize newer R2013+ SAB extraction as brute-force. This is a project limitation statement, not a complete audit of current source or a normative AcDs contract.

body_from_mesh creates a polyhedral ACIS Body from MeshBuilder input, classifies a mesh as closed when each edge has two adjacent faces, and merges coincident vertices. The documentation says R2013+ DXF uses SAB while R2000-R2010 uses SAT. This is an authoring/control route for the selected mesh profile, not proof of general ACIS semantics.

The report describes silent omission of 3DSOLID/REGION entities during DWG-to-DXF writing, including blocks whose only contents are solids. It is a peer-reported failure shape, not evidence of a libdxfrw defect.

sources.revision: open PR state reviewed 2026-10-17; no deployment shown
sources.observed: The proposed ACIS entity writer remains unmerged/undeployed. It is not a released writer, qualified runtime, or independent positive control.

sources.revision: maintainer response and current documentation reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: A FreeCAD maintainer says stock FreeCAD cannot read the proprietary ACIS blob in DXF; current DWG documentation describes external converter choices. This narrows stock-consumer applicability and does not establish libdxfrw carrier correctness or exclude a separately named plugin/modeler route.

sources.revision: working tree over baseline de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9 reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: The current status table marks explicit MESH property-override wire/readback as committed; generated DataStorage threshold and two-page blob01 controls are directly runnable through --datastorage-page-boundaries. Existing ACIS graph tests predominantly use synthetic records/markers; they do not yet substitute for an authored, valid AC1032 SAB body with independently declared analytic expectations.

assessment.peerFailureUse: Use LibreDWG #1411 and ACadSharp #1195 as negative test shapes for silent payload/entity loss and block-nested omission. Do not transfer peer defects to libdxfrw without a local source-bound reproduction.
assessment.validSabControl: Add one bounded synthetic control authored from locally specified closed rectangular-prism meshes. For dimensions 2x3x5 at minimum (11,-7,3) and 1x4x2 at minimum (-13,9,4), independently record respective maxima (13,-4,8) and (-12,13,6), centers (12,-5.5,5.5) and (-12.5,11,5), surface areas 62 and 28, and volumes 30 and 8 before encoding. The control exercises the current DXF->AC1032 DWG->DXF carrier path and per-entity AcDs association; it does not establish general ACIS support.
assessment.evidenceLanes: Report exact carrier/hash and entity-to-AcDs association separately from bare-stream parsing, B-rep validity/metrics, and named native consumer acceptance. Treat ezdxf readback as structural evidence, not a sole semantic oracle. cq-acis/OCCT shares kernel lineage with FreeCAD and is not an independent-kernel vote.
assessment.implementationSpeed: The old MESH override and AcDs page-chain queue entries are complete. Continue with the source-generated valid-SAB control using focused existing targets; do not add ezdxf or peers to CMake/CI/per-slice validation, and do not wait on unavailable external runtimes.
